limitations: Images are review artifacts, not assertions of visual correctness.
Static lab poses advance art time only; they do not simulate match damage, outcome transitions, or a full jump trajectory.
Combat Lab has no walk pose; walking and match transitions require a separate playtest.
The lab uses its native facing for this character; no fighter state is modified to mirror it.
Advantage estimates and automatic dummy placement use MoveSpec; drawn boxes and projectile emission use baseline sprite metadata with match-equivalent fallback.

notes: High-resolution raster Python fighter atlas generated from assets/references/python-fighter-raster-source.png. The source is a prototype-only generated pose sheet with semi-realistic painted sprites, a white blouse, black skirt, and real body poses for the nine close-range attack clips.
Previous generated atlas is kept at assets/placeholder/python-fighter-atlas-backup.png with a matching backup manifest.
Close-range attack hitboxes intentionally fall back to MoveSpec until the raster frames are calibrated in Sprite Studio.
Candidate assembled from explicitly reviewed action frames.
Combat metadata is included only when supplied explicitly in production.json.
Source rectangles and production provenance: python-fighter.provenance.json
